search.enterKeyword: Enter a keyword to start searching
search.limitReachedFiles: Showing the first {{count}} file matches. Refine the query to narrow the result set.
search.limitReachedContent: Showing the first {{count}} content matches. Refine the query to narrow the result set.
search.backendSummary: {{candidateDocs}} candidate docs, {{matchedLines}} matched lines, {{matchedOccurrences}} matched occurrences.

summary.needs_index: Automatic indexing is evaluating this workspace or has selected fallback search. No manual action is needed.
summary.ready: Managed index is ready. Content search can use the indexed backend.
summary.tracking_changes: Managed index is usable and workspace changes are being tracked. After a branch switch the index catches up to the new commit automatically.
summary.refreshing: Refreshing the workspace index with the latest file changes.
summary.limited: Managed index is limited. Search can still fall back; rebuilding the index may restore it.
summary.unavailable: Search index status is unavailable right now.
summary.non_git: This workspace is not a Git repository, so the search index does not apply; content search uses the fallback implementation.

autoIndex.pending: Evaluating whether an index is needed.
autoIndex.eligible: Above the indexing threshold; the index task is starting.
autoIndex.belowThreshold: Only {{files}} files, below the {{threshold}} threshold — searching directly is faster.

indicator.label: Workspace index status
indicator.baseAdvancing: Advancing the index to the latest commit.
indicator.probePending: Reconciling worktree changes; the dirty file counts above are from the last observation.
indicator.probeDegraded: Workspace probe is degraded and the indexed workspace view may stop tracking changes.

empty.selectWorkspace: File tree will be displayed after selecting a workspace

largeFile.title: Large File
largeFile.message: The file is {{size}}, which exceeds 2 MB. Opening large files may cause the interface to freeze. Do you want to continue?

transfer.missingConnection: Remote workspace has no SSH connection id.
